        # This module is installed in the trial directory; a host may expose its
        # explicit trial root through ModelView. Never write to the data directory.
        artifact_root = os.path.abspath(
            getattr(self.model, "trial_dir", None) or os.path.dirname(__file__)
        )
        artifact_dir = os.path.join(artifact_root, "working", "diagnostics")
        os.makedirs(artifact_dir, exist_ok=True)
        artifact_path = os.path.join(artifact_dir, f"{category or 'unlabeled'}_temporal.json")
        result["artifact_path"] = artifact_path
        result["configuration"] = {
            "width": width, "seed": 42, "repetitions": 5,
            "selected_user_order": [str(u) for u in users],
            "candidate_count": 100, "bootstrap_replicates": 2000,
            "minimum_interval_users": 30,
            "primary_includes_unchanged_draws": True,
        }
        temporary_path = None
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                mode="w", dir=artifact_dir, suffix=".json", delete=False
            ) as handle:
                temporary_path = handle.name
                json.dump(result, handle, allow_nan=False)
            os.replace(temporary_path, artifact_path)
        finally:
            if temporary_path and os.path.exists(temporary_path):
                os.unlink(temporary_path)
        return result

                    conditional = [
                        float(np.mean([d[metric] for d in block]))
                        for block in changed_blocks
                        if block and all(d[metric] is not None for d in block)
                    ]
                    report["changed_draw_conditional"][condition][metric] = {
                        "users": len(conditional),
                        "mean": float(np.mean(conditional)) if conditional else None,
                        "interpretation": "Equal-user mean among users with changed draws; conditional descriptive estimand",
                    }
                    complete = all(len(block) == 5 and all(d[metric] is not None for d in block) for block in blocks)
                    report["permutation_mc_se"][condition][metric] = {
                        "users": len(blocks) if complete else 0,

                    "interval_reason": None if complete and draws is not None else "Requires at least 30 complete paired users",
                }
